Subah ki chai ka sabse achha hissa pehli chuski nahi hoti. Pehli chuski neend aur zubaan ke beech ek formal handshake hai. Asli baat aakhri chuski me hoti hai—jab cup thanda ho chuka hota hai aur din apni demands bhejna shuru kar chuka hota hai.

Mere mohalle ki chai ki dukaan par ek aadmi roz 7:40 par aata hai. Blue shirt, thoda sa jhuka hua kandha, aur ek newspaper jise woh kabhi poora nahi padhta. Woh headlines par nazar daalta hai, chai ko do baar phoonkta hai, aur aakhri chuski se pehle paper mod deta hai.

Kal phone ko dusre kamre me rakh kar chai piyo. Khidki ke bahar teen cheezein dekho jinhe tum aam taur par miss kar dete ho. Ye writing exercise nahi; attention exercise hai. [[Bore hone ki kala]] isi attention ka agla lesson hai.

> Jo cheezein roz hoti hain, unhe dekhna band kar dena bhi ek aadat hai.
